content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 10.00 hours will not be entertained

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Adhoc/locum basis against a leave vacancy Period of appointment: 178 days and not more than 89 days at one time

rows.event: Walk-in Interview (reporting 08.30 hrs; interview 10.30 hrs onwards)

content_sections.heading: How Will BARC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification at reporting Shortlisting on highest percentage in MD / DNB (Pathology) if more than 10 candidates respond Interview If more than 10 candidates respond, shortlisting for interview on the highest percentage obtained in MD / DNB (Pathology) The decision of the selection committee is final and binding

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application in the attached format Original certificates: SSLC (for date of birth), SSC, HSC, MBBS, MD, DNB passing certificates Mark-sheets, internship, registration and experience certificates (originals) One set of self-attested copies of certificates One passport size photograph MMC/MNC/MPC/DCI/IPA registration certificate (listed in the application form)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BARC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application format attached to the notice. Report at 08.30 hrs on 23-11-2026 at Conference Room No.1, Ground floor, BARC Hospital near Library, for verification. Bring the filled application, original certificates, one set of self-attested copies and one passport size photograph.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for BARC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BARC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Medical Officer (Pathology).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BARC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Conference Room No.2, Gr. floor, BARC Hospital, Anushakti Nagar, Mumbai.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (on the date of interview).

faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 45,098 p.m. plus DA (pre-revised) as admissible to SO/D; net pay in hand about Rs. 1,20,000.

faq.answer: MD / DNB in the respective specialty (Pathology) from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working hours: Monday to Saturday, 7 hours per day (6 days a week except Sunday and public holidays).

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reporting after 10.00 hours will not be entertained.

faq.answer: Verification at reporting. Shortlisting on highest percentage in MD / DNB (Pathology) if more than 10 candidates respond. Interview. If more than 10 candidates respond, shortlisting for interview on the highest percentage obtained in MD / DNB (Pathology).
